name: Chores
description: Light, repetitive agent tasks — lookups, formatting, quick edits.
capacity: Speed first, then price: fast and cheap models; a modest capability tier (2+) is enough; short contexts are fine.

name: Generic
description: Mixed everyday agent work with no dominant axis.
capacity: Intelligence per dollar: the best PPI; middling speed is fine; context moderate.

name: Researcher
description: Deep-dive questions, analysis, and synthesis — being right beats being fast.
capacity: Peak reasoning: the highest capability tier; speed and price are secondary; long context for long documents.

name: Coder
description: Implementation work — the model that solves the hard part of the task.
capacity: Peak reasoning and strong coding: highest capability tier; speed matters in tight loops; long context for big repos.

name: Orchestrator
description: Plans, routes, and delegates — many cheap calls, one smart coordinator.
capacity: Intelligence per dollar: strong reasoning without the flagship price; speed good enough for many round trips.
